response.justification: While the candidate has extensive experience as a Senior Software Developer with strong technical skills in multiple languages and frameworks, their background is heavily skewed toward JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and other languages, with only limited experience in Java (noted briefly in employment history). Their advanced seniority and lack of direct Java-focused experience may not align well with the entry-level Junior Java Developer role.
